title: Community projects stretch beyond image generators
summary:
A community harvest brought image tools, agents, comics, diagrams, and travel helpers to the showcase, plus a clearer image-model response header.

Four additions to the showcase take different routes through Pollinations: Chaos Canvas turns players’ words into surreal images, EasyGen makes exportable diagrams, ExodusAI brings chat and visual tools to WhatsApp, and Ai Studio adds model and dimension controls for image creation.

The showcase gained browser, mobile-friendly, and desktop image tools alongside chat apps including PrisimAI and Petfuse. The additions include an Arabic coding and IT education platform, Hythme AI. Imagine Draw AI was listed in two batches; it is one project, not two.

Anime Comic Movie assembles generated scenes from character and location images, while MultiAgent coordinates specialized agents for research and other tasks. Other additions use Pollinations for travel insights, prompt organization, and chat with document and image understanding.
